apikey.description: The APIkey to authenticate call to the API

tenant_id.description: The identifier of your tenant (most of the time, your tenant id is a trigram in the url of your TETHRIS instance; eg: https://{tenant_id}.tehtris.net)

alternative_url.description: The base URL of the TEHTRIS API, to set only if it differs from the default one (https://{tenant_id}.api.tehtris.net/api). Provide the full API URL, including the API path (e.g. https://myinstance.api.tehtris.net/api)
